title: AgiBot pledges potential RM1bil investment after PM Anwar meeting
key_facts: AgiBot Innovation, a Chinese humanoid robot company, pledged a potential investment of up to RM1bil in Malaysia by 2035 and 5,000 jobs
Followed a meeting between founder and CEO Deng Taihua and PM Anwar Ibrahim in Hangzhou last week
Anwar met five Chinese firms: AgiBot, ZTE, Alibaba, Geely and Huawei during a three-day visit
AgiBot already partners with i-City on AI Living @ i-City, a planned 500-home development due 2030
More than 100 AgiBot humanoids were deployed earlier this year at i-City's AI World Experience Centre in Shah Alam
quote_evidence: CHINESE humanoid robotics firm AgiBot Innovation has pledged a potential investment of up to RM1bil in Malaysia by 2035, along with the creation of 5,000 job opportunities.
AI Living @ i-City, a 500-home development billed as the world's first AI residence, scheduled for completion in 2030.
why_it_matters_hint: A Chinese humanoid maker is signalling a large, conditional investment in Malaysia after a meeting with the prime minister.
event_date: last week (visit to Hangzhou), reported 5 Oct 2026
notes: Pledge is 'potential' and 'up to'; much of the article is property-marketing talk.
